title: Integration suite timing: a synthetic comparison
method: Synthetic serial totals: repeated setup 180 + execution 120 + cleanup 60 =360 seconds; shared setup 30 + execution 120 + cleanup 10 =160 seconds. Same test selection; excludes CI queueing and downloads. Isolation must be independently verified.
alt: Synthetic suite totals decrease from 360 to 160 seconds when setup and cleanup costs are reduced, with assertion time unchanged.
